title: Keep Admin i18n and IAM tables inside mobile viewport

spec.problem: At 390px, the i18n table expanded the document to 478px and the Admin actor table to 716px, forcing page-level horizontal scroll.

acceptance.text: i18n and IAM admins screens at 390px have no page-level horizontal overflow; the tables remain reachable by keyboard and screen reader.

spec.expected_behavior: Keep wide Admin tables keyboard-scrollable inside their own region so document scrollWidth stays at 390px.
spec.observed_behavior: Headed Chromium at 390x844 showed document scrollWidth 478 for i18n and 716 for IAM admins; the table itself was wider than its card.

red_targets.test: Admin mobile table layout > keeps wide i18n and IAM tables inside the page viewport
red_targets.expect: i18n page has no horizontal overflow
